svg.aria-label: A table of an illustrative skip-price model in which gems equal 74.28 times hours to the power 0.6. One hour costs 74 gems or 62 cents, at 62 cents per hour saved. Twenty-four hours costs 500 gems or 4 dollars 17, at 17 cents per hour saved. One hundred and sixty-eight hours costs 1,607 gems or 13 dollars 39, at 8 cents per hour saved. The price per hour falls as the wait grows.
svg.text: MODEL — NOT A SHIPPED TABLE: gems = 74.28 × hours^0.6, gems priced at $10 / 1,200
remaining gems gems/hour $ $ per hour saved
The curve is concave, so the longest waits are the cheapest per hour —
which is how you would price it if you wanted the largest purchase to feel like the sensible one.
